query:
-- Récupérer les IDs des plantes, molécules et recettes Burkina
SELECT 'plant' as type, id, name FROM plants WHERE name LIKE '%Daniellia%' OR name LIKE '%Boswellia%' OR name LIKE '%Xylopia%' OR name LIKE '%Cymbopogon%' OR name LIKE '%Securidaca%' OR name LIKE '%Lippia%' OR name LIKE '%Vetiver%' OR name LIKE '%Vétiver%' LIMIT 10;
